svg.text: AgentX desktop character: pose sheet, first example
The orb, grown into a small creature. Same round body, the agent's own colours, two eyes, no mouth. It reacts, it never interrupts.
breathes slowly, blinks now and then
you start talking: it stretches up and looks at you
leans in; the rings follow your voice
looks down at its work, eyes half closed
a small bounce with each sentence
a nod: eyes smile, body dips
idle for a while: settles and sleeps
hops and rings on both sides
tilts its head and waits, never interrupts
EACH AGENT KEEPS ITS OWN COLOURS
Example only, issue 458. Vector, drawn in code like the orb today; colours from src/voice/orb-palettes.ts.
